verdict.rationale: Discord is a chat and community platform, not an AI agent or assistant. Acting as an MCP client that consumes tools from plugged-in MCP servers is a different product role from Discord's category. Nothing in the evidence shows Discord ships any MCP-client or tool-consuming AI feature that would make this axis applicable; the docs cover bots, OAuth2, webhooks, the Gateway API and the Social SDK, which are integration surfaces for developers rather than MCP tool consumption.
